risk_if_not_implemented: Without Automated Tools to Support Logical Data Location, sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Retention / Inability to Dispose of Data (R-AM-3), Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Data & Asset Classification
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure data and assets are categorized in accordance with applicable statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements.
compensating_control_1.justification: Data & Asset Classification (DCH-04) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Automated Tools to Support Information Location (DCH-29.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
